about.heading: About the company
paragraphs: For over 20 years, Barry Smith Electrical Contractors Ltd has been delivering trusted electrical contracting services to domestic, commercial, and industrial clients across Ireland. Built on a reputation for quality workmanship, reliability, and exceptional customer service, we have grown into a respected contractor known for delivering projects safely, on time, and within budget.

We provide a complete range of electrical services, from design and installation through to maintenance and ongoing support. Our experienced team works with homeowners, property developers, architects, engineering consultants, main contractors, and businesses to deliver tailored electrical solutions that meet the highest industry standards.
expertise: Solar PV (photovoltaic) installations and renewable energy solutions
Fire alarm, CCTV, security, and access control systems

services.title: Domestic
services.body: A comprehensive range of domestic electrical services across new builds and renovations — switch board upgrading, rewires, solar panel installations and other energy-efficient technologies.

staff.heading: Staff, quality & safety
paragraphs: We pride ourselves on quality workmanship and reliability. All of our staff are qualified to the required industry standards, and ongoing training ensures skills are maintained at an optimum level. Our customer charter is central to our operations and we strive to exceed our clients' expectations through a reliable, professional and dependable service.
Barry Smith Electrical Contractors Ltd has an exemplary record in completing projects to the highest standard of health and safety.

contact.heading: Contact us
contact.intro: Beginning with an initial consultation, we listen to your requirements and our design team works closely with you to deliver a comprehensive set of electrical designs.

domestic.heading: Domestic work
domestic.intro: Alongside developments and commercial contracts, we carry out domestic jobs across Dublin and Leinster:

ev.heading: EV charger installation
ev.intro: We supply and install home electric vehicle chargers across Dublin and Leinster, or install a charger you have already bought. Every installation is carried out by our Safe Electric registered electricians, certified and tested to current Irish wiring standards.
ev.grantBody: Homeowners with off-street parking can claim up to €300 towards the cost of a home charger through the SEAI EV Home Charger Grant. You don't need to own an electric car yet to apply. The grant requires a Safe Electric registered electrician, and we provide the completion certificate and test records you need for your payment claim.
ev.grantLinkText: SEAI EV Home Charger Grant details
included: Site survey and advice on charger location and cable route
Supply and installation of a wall-mounted home charger, or installation of your own
Fuse board and supply checks, with upgrades where needed
Certification and test records for the SEAI grant claim
